critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines 53-75: put_object/get_object helpers exist but no FastAPI route exposes them - dead code.
init_storage() is synchronous (requests) inside async startup - acceptable for one-shot but storage_key is a module global that won't refresh if remote key rotates.
put_object uses requests (sync) inside async handler contexts - will block the event loop. Should use httpx.AsyncClient or run in threadpool.
GET /matches (line 497) could be inefficient for users with many matches - ok for now.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env is expanded with allow_credentials=True; code correctly filters out '*' so actual allow list uses explicit origins + preview regex - OK.
POST /matches duplicate detection uses (parent_id, nanny_id, status) - correctly covers both initiation directions.
DELETE /matches allows either party to delete with no notification to the other - consider notifying.
